Afficher sur la carte les PNJ et faction: Show the NPCs and factions of this place and its sub-places on the graph
Ajouter un PNJ ou une faction…: Add an NPC or a faction…
Aucun PNJ ni faction relié à ce lieu. Mo: No NPC or faction linked to this place. Edit the sheet to add some.
Aucun lieu cité avec @ dans ce scénario: No place mentioned with @ in this scenario or its pages.
Aucun sous-lieu. Découpez une ville en q: No sub-places. Split a city into districts, a building into rooms…
Choisir un lieu permet d’« entrer » dans: Choosing a place lets you “enter” this map from a wider map where this place (or one of its parents) is pinned.
Choisissez d’abord pour chaque champ en: First choose a version for each conflicting field
Choose the place that will contain it.
Créer, renommer, supprimer les types de: Create, rename and delete place types, and choose their icons
Create some in the place index.
Discrète : pour une carte qui porte déjà: Discreet: for a map that already shows its own symbols, an invisible clickable area sits on top of them (circle on hover). Type icon: the image uploaded in Place types, shown large.
Facultatif : par défaut, « Carte de » su: Optional: defaults to “Map of” followed by the place shown, or the file name.
Glisser sur la carte, ou cliquer puis cl: Drag onto the map, or click it, then click the map
Glissez un lieu sur la carte, ou cliquez: Drag a place onto the map, or click it, then click the map. Drag a pin to move it.
Image importée gardée en pleine définiti: Uploaded images are kept at full resolution up to 8192 px (20 MB at most; a large JPEG is the most compact), and shown at 4096 px first. Images already in Maze are limited to 1600 px.
Importez une image de fond (carte d’un s: Upload a background image (a map of a sector, a region, a city), then pin your places on it. Choosing a place shows its sub-places in a ring; a map can also represent a place, so you can “enter” it.
Invisibles, posées sur les symboles de l: Invisible, placed over the map's symbols
The place and its images will be deleted. NPCs and factions linked to it are not affected.

Le lieu et ses images seront supprimés..one: The place and its images will be deleted. Its sub-place will move up one level. NPCs and factions linked to it are not affected.
Le lieu et ses images seront supprimés..other: The place and its images will be deleted. Its {n} sub-places will move up one level. NPCs and factions linked to it are not affected.

Les ajouts d’images et les changements d: Added images and changes to NPCs and factions are saved immediately.
Les derniers lieux ouverts sur cet appar: The last places opened on this device will appear here.
Les sous-lieux d’un lieu épinglé apparai: Sub-places of a pinned place appear in its ring: no need to pin them.
Les types servent à classer les lieux (m: Types classify places (menus, icons in the tree, on sheets and on maps). An icon can be an uploaded image, for example a symbol from your map's legend (white background removed automatically). Deleting a type moves its places to the type “{kind}”.
Les épingles restent en place (positions: Pins stay in place (positions are relative to the image).
Lui donner sa propre épingle sur cette c: Give it its own pin on this map
L’image de fond et les épingles seront s: The background image and pins will be deleted. The places themselves are not affected.
L’image importée dans Types de lieux: The image uploaded in Place types
Nobody is linked to this place yet.
Placer, déplacer ou retirer des lieux su: Pin, move or remove places on the map
Rangez ici les lieux qui reviennent d’un: Keep here the places that come back from one session to the next: regions, cities, districts, taverns, hideouts… Each place can contain sub-places, host NPCs and factions, and be mentioned in scenarios with @.
Regrouper par type les listes de {n} lie: Group lists of {n} or more places by type
Réglages de la carte : nom, lieu représe: Map settings: name, place shown, pin style, background image
Sur la carte : cliquer pour la montrer: On the map: click to show it
Taverne du Hareng Saur, Haute ville…: The Salted Herring Inn, Upper Town…
Touchez un lieu, puis l’endroit de la ca: Tap a place, then the spot on the map where it goes. Drag a pin to move it.
Tout replier (garder le chemin du lieu a: Collapse all (keep the path to the current place)
Un type par image, nommé d’après le fich: One type per image, named after the file (“Fortress-city.png”); an existing type with the same name gets the image
Une phrase, affichée dans les listes et: One sentence, shown in lists and previews.
Voir ce lieu sur la carte « {name} »: See this place on the map “{name}”

{n} lieu de ce type passera au type « {k.one: {n} place of this type will switch to the type “{kind}”.
{n} lieu de ce type passera au type « {k.other: {n} places of this type will switch to the type “{kind}”.

Épingler sur l’accueil des lieux: Pin to the places home page
Épinglez les lieux où vous revenez souve: Pin the places you come back to often: the star on their sheet, or the ⋯ menu in the tree.
